name: Haritaki Powder 100gm – For Healthy Immunity
original_description:
### Haritaki Powder 100gm – Traditional Ayurvedic Formulation

Rooted in ancient Ayurvedic tradition, Haritaki Powder is made from the dried fruit of Terminalia chebula, revered for its grounding and balancing properties in classical texts. Sourced from ethically harvested, sun-dried fruits and stone-ground into a fine, pure powder, this formulation honors the wisdom of time-honored practices.

Haritaki is traditionally used in Ayurveda as part of daily wellness rituals, often combined with other natural ingredients to support holistic well-being. Its gentle nature makes it suitable for regular use within a balanced lifestyle.

This 100gm pack offers a convenient, unadulterated form of Haritaki — free from additives, fillers, or artificial preservatives. Ideal for those seeking to incorporate traditional botanicals into their daily routine.

How to Use:
Take 3 grams (approx. ½ tsp) of powder once or twice daily, mixed with warm water, honey, or ghee — as per personal preference or guidance from a qualified practitioner.

Storage:
Keep in a cool, dry place. Seal tightly after use to preserve freshness.

---

Haritaki is a traditional Ayurvedic herb. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition. Consult a qualified Ayurvedic practitioner before use, especially if pregnant, nursing, or under medical care.

---
